append.detail: createInviteLink in app/(main)/admin/actions.ts gated on the global community host rung (requireCommunityOps) and never checked that the caller manages the circle id passed, so any host could mint an invite into any private or paid circle, join it free, and disable the real host's link. It now asks getCircleCapabilities(circleId) and passes circle.editSettings through requireScopedManage, the same gate updateCircle uses (platform operators keep global reach). joinViaInviteLink additionally refuses a link whose circle is archived, matching the join page. Pinned by app/(main)/admin/invite-link-scope.test.ts: a host without the circle capability is refused with no write, a manager mints a link, an archived circle refuses the join, an open circle still joins.
